    # Equal values (different representations) -> None
    assert compare_one(1, 1) is None
    assert compare_one(1, "1") is None
    assert compare_one("1,5", 1.5) is None

    # Numeric comparisons
    assert compare_one(1, 2) == 2
    assert compare_one(2, 1) == 2
    assert compare_one(1.5, 2.5) == 2.5

    # String with comma decimal
    assert compare_one("1,5", 1) == "1,5"      # original string returned
    assert compare_one("2,3", "2,45") == "2,45"

    # Mixed types
    assert compare_one(5, "4,5") == 5          # int beats comma-string
    assert compare_one("6,01", 6) == "6,01"    # 6.01 > 6, string returned

    # Negative numbers
    assert compare_one(-1, -2) == -1
    assert compare_one("-1,5", -2) == "-1,5"
```
